verdict.rationale: Extend is a document-parsing and OCR platform, so multilingual parsing fidelity is a fair axis for it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions language support, CJK scripts, or right-to-left scripts. Generic claims such as 'Agentic OCR' and 'unmatched accuracy' do not show non-English fidelity.

support.subject: As a developer, non-English documents — including CJK and right-to-left scripts — parse with the same fidelity as English
